commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@f2f1a0ab1350 (#25347)

Dropped carried bazel backport f58327a6b604. LLVM upstream has it now
(486a7fa4fd8d).

Reverted d71acc8f3779 ("[mlir] Avoid eager invalidation in
`DeadnessCache` (#244443)"). It causes a heap-use-after-free in
DeadnessCache::flushInvalidations() during Flow canonicalization, e.g.
when compiling the e2e linalg pack_dynamic_inner_tiles and unpack tests.

Since b4e067331a4f ("[Support][mlir][llvm-mc] Match each verify
directive once by default (#233308)"), duplicate diagnostics fail
--verify-diagnostics. The patterns behind
encode_host_tensors_packing.mlir and unfuse_batch_norm.mlir created IR
before failing with a diagnostic, so the greedy driver re-ran them and
repeated the diagnostic. Check for failure before creating IR in
calculateStorageElementCountInBytes and UnfuseBatchNormTrainingPattern.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[Codegen][GPU] Use bounds for dynamic reduction launch sizes

Dynamic reductions use a large size estimate even when existing range
assumptions bound the reduction. Use those bounds for launch configuration
while retaining dynamic masking and fallback behavior.

Carry range facts from direct HAL bindings through load_from_buffer, and
keep at least one subgroup for small bounds. Add CUDA/AMD configuration,
export specialization, and lowering regressions.

Assisted-by: OpenAI Codex
